Senses.Explanation: 千聖不傳 is “not transmitted by a thousand sages.” Records use the phrase in declarations and questions about what even the sages do not hand down; later quotations preserve the wording but belong to their immediate speakers. The exact stored witnesses delimit this use across the selected works.
